```{=html}
<script>
// Waveform of a code-switched sentence. One bar per slot; each word gets slots
// by length, silence between words. Seeded so it is the same on every load.
// Pointer scrubs a playhead; "Transcribe" sweeps it and reveals words like live ASR.
(function () {
  const fig = document.getElementById("cs-wave");
  const svg = fig && fig.querySelector("svg");
  if (!svg) return;
  const words = [["khdemt","dar"],["3la","dar"],["le","fr"],["modèle","fr"],["bzaf,","dar"],
                 ["but","en"],["the","en"],["eval","en"],["was","en"],["lying.","en"]];
  const calm = matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches;
  let s = 42;
  const rand = () => (s = (s * 1664525 + 1013904223) % 4294967296) / 4294967296;
  const W = 600, H = 96, bar = 3, step = 5, gap = 2;
  const total = Math.floor(W / step);
  const letters = words.reduce((n, [w]) => n + w.length, 0);
  const speech = total - gap * (words.length - 1);
  const ns = "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg";

  // Caption: one span per word so it can follow the playhead
  const text = fig.querySelector(".cs-text");
  const spans = words.map(([w, lang]) => {
    const el = document.createElement("span");
    el.className = "cs-word " + lang;
    el.textContent = w;
    text.append(el, " ");
    return el;
  });

  const bars = [], span = words.map(() => [Infinity, -Infinity]);
  let x = 0, i = 0;
  words.forEach(([w, lang], k) => {
    const n = Math.max(3, Math.round(speech * w.length / letters));
    for (let j = 0; j < n && x < total; j++, x++, i++) {
      const env = Math.sin(Math.PI * (j + 0.5) / n);        // word envelope
      const syl = 0.6 + 0.4 * Math.abs(Math.sin(j * 1.7));  // syllable ripple
      const h = Math.max(4, H * 0.8 * env * syl * (0.55 + 0.45 * rand()));
      const r = document.createElementNS(ns, "rect");
      r.setAttribute("x", x * step); r.setAttribute("y", (H - h) / 2);
      r.setAttribute("width", bar); r.setAttribute("height", h);
      r.setAttribute("rx", 1.5); r.setAttribute("class", lang);
      r.style.setProperty("--i", i);
      svg.appendChild(r);
      bars.push({ r, cx: x * step + bar / 2, k });
      span[k][0] = Math.min(span[k][0], x * step);
      span[k][1] = Math.max(span[k][1], x * step + bar);
    }
    if (k < words.length - 1) x += gap;
  });

  const head = document.createElementNS(ns, "line");
  head.setAttribute("class", "cs-head");
  head.setAttribute("y1", 0); head.setAttribute("y2", H);
  svg.appendChild(head);
  fig.classList.add("is-drawing");

  // Move the playhead to px (viewBox units). Bars near it lift; the word under it lights up.
  let current = -1;
  function seek(px, reveal) {
    head.setAttribute("x1", px); head.setAttribute("x2", px);
    for (const b of bars) {
      const d = Math.abs(b.cx - px);
      const lift = calm ? 1 : 1 + 0.45 * Math.max(0, 1 - d / 40) ** 2;
      b.r.style.transform = `scaleY(${lift})`;
      b.r.classList.toggle("is-past", b.cx <= px);
    }
    const k = span.findIndex(([a, b]) => px >= a - step && px <= b + step);
    if (k !== current) {
      spans.forEach((el, n) => el.classList.toggle("is-active", n === k));
      current = k;
    }
    if (reveal) spans.forEach((el, n) => el.classList.toggle("is-heard", span[n][0] <= px));
  }
  function release() {
    fig.classList.remove("is-scrubbing", "is-transcribing");
    bars.forEach(b => { b.r.style.transform = ""; b.r.classList.remove("is-past"); });
    spans.forEach(el => el.classList.remove("is-active", "is-heard"));
    current = -1;
  }
  const toX = e => {
    const box = svg.getBoundingClientRect();
    return Math.min(W, Math.max(0, (e.clientX - box.left) / box.width * W));
  };

  svg.addEventListener("pointermove", e => {
    if (fig.classList.contains("is-transcribing")) return;
    fig.classList.add("is-scrubbing");
    seek(toX(e), false);
  });
  svg.addEventListener("pointerleave", () => {
    if (!fig.classList.contains("is-transcribing")) release();
  });

  const btn = fig.querySelector(".cs-play");
  let raf = 0;
  btn.addEventListener("click", () => {
    cancelAnimationFrame(raf);
    release();
    fig.classList.add("is-scrubbing", "is-transcribing");
    btn.disabled = true;
    const t0 = performance.now(), dur = 3200;
    const tick = now => {
      const p = Math.min(1, (now - t0) / dur);
      seek(p * W, true);
      if (p < 1) { raf = requestAnimationFrame(tick); return; }
      setTimeout(() => { release(); btn.disabled = false; btn.textContent = "Transcribe again"; }, 900);
    };
    raf = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
  });
})();
</script>
```

## How I work

::: {.principles}
**I start from the constraint, not the model.** At Orange Business the network was air-gapped and the invoices came in 1,000+ carrier formats. Those two facts shaped the system more than any model benchmark did.

**I don't trust a number I haven't broken down.** Several seeds, one ablation per claim, errors read by hand and counted by slice. If a gain disappears on the second run, it was never a gain. I [wrote about this](posts/trustworthy-ml-results/index.qmd).

**The data pipeline matters more than the architecture.** On Arabic hate speech, normalization and tokenization for dialect mattered more than which BERT I fine-tuned. For low-resource languages, the preprocessing is the moat.

**I ship.** I co-founded illico.ma and own its stack end to end, from the Next.js app to CI/CD on AWS. I also build local document AI (invoices, orders, contracts) that runs with no cloud API.

**I think in three languages.** Darija, French and English, often in the same sentence. That's why code-switched speech is the research problem I want to work on.
:::

## Now

Founder and full-stack developer at illico.ma. Before that, I spent six months taking a vision-language document validation system to production at Orange Business Morocco.

**Research interests (exploring).** Speech and NLP for Moroccan Darija and code-switched French–Arabic–English, document understanding under constrained compute, and evaluation methodology.
